### Added

- *(gitops)* Add --skip-encryption to add management-cluster and work without a secrets directory in [#2240](https://github.com/giantswarm/kubectl-gs/pull/2240) by [@pipo02mix](https://github.com/pipo02mix)
- *(deploy)* Let deploy chart --values-from set the values key and mark a source optional in [#2243](https://github.com/giantswarm/kubectl-gs/pull/2243) by [@pipo02mix](https://github.com/pipo02mix)
- *(gitops)* Set the cluster app version and release in add workload-cluster in [#2246](https://github.com/giantswarm/kubectl-gs/pull/2246) by [@pipo02mix](https://github.com/pipo02mix)

### Changed

- Krew index update no longer names architectbot in [#2255](https://github.com/giantswarm/kubectl-gs/pull/2255) by [@weatherhog](https://github.com/weatherhog)

### Fixed

- *(deps)* Update module github.com/giantswarm/pagekit to v0.3.3 in [#2258](https://github.com/giantswarm/kubectl-gs/pull/2258) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- *(deps)* Update module github.com/giantswarm/telemetrydeck-go to v0.3.13 in [#2259](https://github.com/giantswarm/kubectl-gs/pull/2259) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- *(deps)* Update module go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 to v3.0.6 in [#2257](https://github.com/giantswarm/kubectl-gs/pull/2257) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
